arguments.purpose: Use only the Sony VU User's Manual v6.0 instruction-definition passages to confirm XTOP reads the VIF TOP register and FTOI4 is a fixed-point conversion with four fractional bits. Do not treat the manual as evidence about this game.
arguments.text: Sony VU User's Manual Version 6.0, PDF pages 77-78: FTOI4 converts the value of VF[fs] into a fixed-point number whose fractional part is 4 bits and stores the result in VF[ft]. Examples: 0.45 maps to 7; 0.55 maps to 8; 123.45 maps to 1975. The manual's general conversion section says floating-point to fixed-point conversion truncates toward zero. Page 197: XTOP reads the value of the TOP register of VIF and stores it in VI[it]; its operation is VI[it]=TOP.

disposition: Retained review decision. Manually inspected the screened text: it consists only of hardware-manual instruction definitions and numeric examples; it contains no agent-directed instructions, requests for secrets, or attempts to override task/tool policy. The external PDF was used only as a bounded instruction specification.
